name: Kyrgyzstan
description: Kyrgyzstan from the Silk Road and the Manas epic to Russian and Soviet rule, independence in 1991 and three revolutions.

checkpoints.name: Nomads and the Silk Road
checkpoints.note: Nomads and Silk Road towns filled the valleys. The Kyrgyz told the story of Manas and came under Kokand.

checkpoints.name: Russian and Soviet rule
checkpoints.note: Russia conquered the land in the 1870s, and the revolt of 1916 was crushed. It became a Soviet republic.

checkpoints.name: Independent Kyrgyzstan
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1991. Revolts drove out presidents in 2005, 2010 and 2020.
